title: Active-passive standby readiness
objective: Compare warm/cold standby; a healthy shallow endpoint is not complete readiness.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
preconditions: Open the owned HTML bundle in a browser with local JavaScript enabled.
Region Alder is the fictional active region; Region Birch is the fictional passive region.
All standby, capacity, health, cache, dependency, authentication, state, recovery and journey fields are declared data, not real resources or operations.
actions: Select one fixed standby fixture and one original client interruption budget.
Reset current rehearsal without clearing completed or unfinished history.
expectedAssertions: Shallow HTTP 200 is not complete readiness.
All required compute, cache, dependency, authentication and state assertions must pass.
Warm recovery is 4000 synthetic ms; cold recovery is 20000 synthetic ms where full-path evidence allows admission.
Each client keeps the original budget, session/state checks and effect attribution.
Cold recovery under 24000 ms may meet client budgets but cannot make cold standby ready at the outset.
Known failures dominate aggregate verdicts; missing evidence remains unknown.
Blocked admission is not observed alternate routing, and eventual completion does not erase interruptions.
Resets retain prior budgets, failed/unknown checks and the unchanged session allowance.

limits.persistence: none; reload starts a new independent session
